themes.title: Right-wing parties challenge voting rules and electoral integrity
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across several nations are actively contesting voting procedures, alleging electoral fraud, or facing backlash over measures that impact political participation. From raising alarms over missing ballots to tightening mail-in voting rules and auditing voter files, electoral mechanics have become a central ideological battleground.

Backlash over trade tariffs, agricultural imports, and party convention spending highlights growing fault lines between grassroots interest groups and national leadership.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right leaders are reshaping public spending priorities by reducing funding for federal social programs, research initiatives, and healthcare support, while proposing structural labor market reforms to redirect citizens into the workforce.

Direct grassroots outreach remains a key mechanism for maintaining influence and rallying supporters despite broader political headwinds.
